_doc: Per-plugin declaration that the on-disk byte layout was verified against an AUTHORITATIVE external reference (spec document or reference implementation). Consumed by scripts/gen_verification_tiers.py: a plugin with a synthetic test AND an entry here rates T2; without an entry, a synthetic test alone rates T3 (green tests against invented specs are exactly the fabrication trap, see docs/VERIFICATION_PLAN.md). Only add an entry with concrete evidence (MF-NNN commit that did the cross-check). Keys are plugin symbols from gen_format_list.py.

d64.spec_source: VICE D64 sizes incl. error-block trailer + 40/42-track variants

d88.spec_source: pc98.org D88 + MAME d88_dsk (DDAM @+07, FDC status @+08)

dc42.spec_source: DiscFerret/Mini-vMac DC42 checksum (BE16 word add, ROR32 1)

dmk.spec_source: David Keil DMK spec (openMSX DMK-Format-Details) + WD177x CRC-CCITT pinned to check value 0x29B1

dsk_cpc.spec_source: EDSK uPD765 ST1/ST2 status-bit semantics (bit5 CRC, ST2 bit6 deleted); MF-332 verified the dsk_cpc implementation (the separate 'edsk' plugin in amstrad/ remains untested)

fdi.spec_source: SAMdisk ReadFDI (src/samdisk/fdi.cpp, in-tree) + WoS format FAQ

hfe.spec_source: HxC hfev3_loader.c opcode semantics (v3 decode + RAND weak bits); HxC HFE docs (v1)

lisa_twiggy.spec_source: bitsavers Lisa Twiggy ZCAV zone table (46 tracks/side, 22..15 spt)

nfd.spec_source: pc98.org nfdr0/nfdr1 + tomari/d88split nfd2mhlt.pl (r1 skip accounting spec-only, no real r1 corpus yet)

savedskf.spec_source: Deark modules/fat.c de_run_loaddskf + foreign/dskdcmps.h (uncompressed path only; LZW deferred). Standalone API (src/formats/pc/uft_savedskf.c), not in the plugin registry

scp.spec_source: cbmstuff SCP image spec (48-byte FPCS footer, bitcell track length)

woz.spec_source: Applesauce WOZ reference v1/v2/2.1 (chunk layout, CRC32, WRIT logical refs)
